outline:
嵌入式即時作業系統(Real-Time OS)與進階微控制器硬體架構與操作原理，程式語言介紹，數位及類比系統訊號感測與控制，通訊介面程式設計，韌體設計與專題實作。
Hardware structure and operating principles of micro-controllers, programming language, digital/analog signal sensing and control, communication protocols, firmware design and hands-on project.
schedule:
Week 1-2: Architecture of MCU
Week 3: Heap Memory Management
Week 4-5: Task Management
Week 6-7: Queue Management
Week 8:  Midtern
Week 9-10: Software Timer Management
Week 11-12: Interrupt Management
Week 13-14: Resource Management
Week 15-16: Event Groups
Week 17: Task Notifications
Week 18: Final &Project Presentation
